subject: Re: Novaria LLM inference pilot — scheduling and next steps
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@novaria.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novaria.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Novaria LLM inference pilot — scheduling & agenda

Hi Alex / Samantha,

Thanks again for the time on our discovery call yesterday. Per our conversation I booked a short technical demo for next Friday, Feb 17 at 11:00 PT so your engineering and product leads can see the inference flow, cost/latency tradeoffs, and the KV cache demo.

Agenda (attached: Novaria-demo-agenda.pdf):
- 11:00 intro & success criteria (10m)
- 11:10 infra + routing & caching demo (20m)
- 11:30 Q&A and next steps (20m)

Meeting link: https://meet.redwood.com/meet/novaria-1157
If that time doesn't work we'll find an alternate — appreciate confirmation by EOD Tuesday.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Novaria-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

From: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@novaria.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novaria.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 15:03:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Novaria LLM inference pilot — scheduling & agenda

Vanessa —

Appreciate you locking this in. Quick update from our side: our Q2 roadmap just got reprioritized yesterday during the leadership offsite; engineering headcount is being reallocated to a payments migration and two customer-facing features. Given that, we need to deprioritize the LLM/inference pilot for now and pause any scheduled demos.

There are a few constraints driving this: our product lead (Samantha) is traveling next week, and the eng team won't have bandwidth until the end of Q2. We absolutely want to revisit later — this is not a 'no' — but it will likely be 8–10 weeks before we can re-engage.

Would you mind:
- Pausing the live demo for the moment
- Sending over a short recording or a one-pager we can tuck into the roadmap doc
- Checking back mid-April to see where things land?

Sorry for the curveball — leadership asked for tight focus this quarter.

Best,
Alex Nguyen
Director, Data Platforms | Novaria Health
alex.nguyen@novaria.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@novaria.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novaria.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 16:20:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Novaria LLM inference pilot — scheduling & agenda

Alex / team —

Totally understand the need to reallocate. A couple quick thoughts from our side as you pause:

- We can put together a 10–15 minute recorded walkthrough that highlights the parts you care about (routing policies, KV cache behavior on long docs, and cost estimates for your projected token volumes).
- If it helps internal budgeting, we can offer a credits package to cover an abbreviated pilot when you come back (I can pull numbers together; Vanessa — can you confirm what credit levels are typical for this stage?)
- We can stitch together a one-page summary to drop into your roadmap doc with the key tradeoffs and dependencies.

If you want to keep the technical environment (sandbox) active for a few weeks so engineers can poke at it asynchronously, we can arrange that too.

Happy to defer to Vanessa on next steps and timing.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Manager, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@novaria.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novaria.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novaria LLM inference pilot — scheduling & agenda

Alex —

Totally get the reprioritization and thanks for the clear note. We'll pause the live slot and mark the opportunity as on hold in our pipeline. A few concrete things from our side to make re-engagement painless: 

1) I've attached a very short mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan.pdf) with suggested check-in dates (we propose 2028-04-16 and 2028-05-07), the minimal engineering touchpoints, and a suggested pilot scope so you can drop it into your roadmap doc.
2) Marcus will record a 12-minute demo focused on the infra bits you called out; I'll upload the file to Drive and include a link. We attached the recording here as a stub (demo-recording.mp4) for your convenience.
3) We'll keep a sandbox tenant active for 60 days unless you ask us to terminate it earlier — if you'd prefer we pause it sooner just say the word.
4) I'll check back on 2028-04-16 as an agreed tentative re-engagement date; feel free to change that if your internal timeline shifts.

If you want any written collateral or a one-pager tailored to the payments migration constraints (e.g., data residency / PCI considerations) Marcus and I can draft that and send over by next Wednesday.

Thanks again — we'll stand by and work at your cadence.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com

Attachments:
- mutual_action_plan.pdf (PDF, 18KB)
- demo-recording.mp4 (MP4 stub, 12MB)
